items.title: Micron (MU) Stock Looks Cheap, But Not Like A Clear Bargain
items.summary: Micron Technology stock has recorded an extremely strong three year run, yet current valuation checks flag a mixed picture rather than a clear bargain or clear overvaluation. After such a rapid rise, the key issue for you is whether the recent price fully reflects the AI memory story that Micron is now closely associated with. Micron Technology has returned about 13x over the past three years, which puts extra focus on whether recent gains are already pricing in much of the AI driven growth...
